findings.title: Calibration > Accuracy for Sports Betting ROI
findings.finding: Models selected by calibration (Brier score) yield +34.69% ROI vs -35.17% ROI for accuracy-selected models on NBA data. Validates our Brier-first multi-objective approach. Key insight: Brier score IS the correct objective function for betting value extraction.
findings.action: No change needed — our Brier-primary GA objective is already aligned with this finding.

findings.title: TabICL v2 (2026) — Tabular Foundation Model Beats CatBoost at Scale
findings.finding: TabICL v2 handles 500K samples with 2-stage column-then-row attention, 10x faster than TabPFNv2, outperforms CatBoost on large datasets (>10K). Pre-trained on synthetic data with distribution-aware column embeddings. NOT CPU-deployable in our architecture (requires GPU inference), but signals that 200-feature tree models may be near ceiling on CPU. GPU Colab sessions should test TabICL.
